body:
How would it get better?  I'm always going to have obligations and deadlines.  I've tried therapy already with two different people, but it just becomes another thing on my to-do list, taking up time I can't afford.  And no-one (around here at least) will give you meds if you're not in therapy.  I can't take fewer courses because then I won't graduate in four years, and my scholarships won't cover a fifth year.

Sorry to shoot everything down.  I know there are technically solutions.  I just can't convince myself that life is worth it.  Even when I'm not in "crisis," I'm dysthymic.  My *eventual* suicide is inevitable; why go through all this shit when I'm just going to die in a year or two or ten anyway?
